reviews.text: My flight was cancelled and I had to look for a hotel with 24hrs reception and good transport possibilies from/to the airport. The surrounding of the hotel and the building itself did not appear very friendly. But there was this really nice staff at the reception. I was also surprised when I opened the door to the room. It was newly renovated, clean and with the comfort you need. Best to say is, that it was 5-10min by taxi to the airport, but also public transport is just a few minutes walk away. There is a bus bringing you to the airport and the tram that brings you to the city center of Prague.
